Dimmable white light, providing the same look and feel of traditional halogen MR16 lamps. Recreates backlight effect similar to halogen dichroic lamps. Full glass design, preventing colours clashing between the lamp and fixture. Works with magnetic and compatible electronic transformers. Offers more than 100,000 switching cycles. 12V AC/DC.
